name: Redwood Research
summary: A nonprofit in Berkeley, founded in 2021 and led by Buck Shlegeris, that researches risks from AI systems that work against their developers: it started the field of AI control (keeping a model safe to use even if it is trying to subvert its monitors), showed with Anthropic that a production model can fake alignment, and advises AI companies and the UK AI Security Institute. It ran the Constellation research centre until spinning it off in 2023 and 2024.
